admission.justification: The split is stated in the reviewer role and review operation and exercised by the registered Reviewer-binding round test.

applicability: Every independent leaf code review and its separate memory check.

statement: The Reviewer owns ordinary code rounds and newly begun post-landing memory rounds in separate task-document lanes, with independent sealed findings, reports and counts under the same settings limit and recorded approvals.
